primary_datasets.role: Primary A — full OG–NSD stack using ATM gold ontology

metadata_to_fill.source: Source document URL: https://www.cs.toronto.edu/~sme/CSC340F/2005/assignments/inspections/atm.pdf ("Requirements document for an automated teller machine network"). ATM requirement statements were extracted and normalized from this document.
metadata_to_fill.license: License for the source PDF is not explicitly stated in the document URL. Keep attribution to the original URL and treat extracted requirements as research-use derivative unless redistribution permission is clarified.
metadata_to_fill.construction_notes: Normalized to canonical [{title,text}] format using scripts/normalize_requirements_json.py-style procedure; title fields reassigned to Requirement 1..30; non-input annotation fields removed.

primary_datasets.role: Primary B — same pipeline, different vocabulary and shapes

metadata_to_fill.source: PhysioNet MIMIC-IV v2.2 (https://physionet.org/content/mimiciv/2.2/) and MIMIC-IV-ED v2.2 (https://physionet.org/content/mimic-iv-ed/2.2/) used as real-world healthcare semantics anchors for visits, clinicians, prescriptions, labs, billing, and vital-sign workflows.
metadata_to_fill.license: Upstream data access/redistribution is governed by PhysioNet credentialed data terms (MIMIC access agreement and cited data-use requirements). The in-repo requirement corpus is a derived abstraction for research experiments.
metadata_to_fill.construction_notes: Derived from MIMIC clinical workflow concepts (encounters, orders, results, prescriptions, billing/events), then normalized to canonical [{title,text}] format and re-indexed as Requirement 1..30 for cross-domain comparability.

journal_claims: Workflow consistency across ordering and fulfillment

metadata_to_fill.source: Online Retail dataset (UCI ML Repository dataset 352) used as real-world retail semantics anchor; requirements corpus authored as faithful abstraction of entities/relations (orders, products, customers, payments, inventory, shipment).
metadata_to_fill.license: UCI dataset 352 license: CC BY 4.0 (as declared on UCI page). Derived requirement statements in this repo are a curated abstraction for ontology tasks.
metadata_to_fill.construction_notes: Requirement statements were constructed from UCI transactional schema concepts and normalized to [{title,text}] format. Gold ontology, SHACL shapes, and CQs are version-locked to this 30-line corpus.

auxiliary_bundle.role: Supports theory + controlled comparisons without doubling main corpus size

suggested_contents.exemplars: Small frozen FR snippets used in few-shot / ontology-aware prompts (same IDs across seeds).
suggested_contents.stress: Short JSONL of adversarial or ambiguous NL lines for failure taxonomy (F1–F10) case studies.
suggested_contents.third_domain_seed: Optional minimal TTL + 5–15 reqs + shapes for a 'novel domain' paragraph OR leave empty.
